title: Two wizards: an abruptly disconnected wizard vanishes after the link-dead window
notes: The included two-wizards run verifies that a killed client is visibly link-dead and can resume its original
mobile before the retention deadline. This run then kills the resumed companion and waits for the configured
300-second link-dead window to expire; the main client's screenshot records the companion's removal.

steps.name: the resumed companion process ends without a logout
the main wizard sees the resumed companion link-dead
the link-dead window expires and the companion disappears
steps.pattern: Session \d+'s wizard {companion_wizard_guid} was taken away from the (\d+) wizard\(s\) still in instance

steps.name: the main wizard sees the expired companion removed
